watch.summary: The streamer hypes himself up to roll an egg across an obstacle course, but panics and hesitates at the last second, causing the egg to fall and break.

beats.what: The streamer panics while trying to time his move on the platform.
He hypes himself up and announces, 'This is it, we go!'
He suddenly panics and tries to backtrack, shouting 'No no no, actually we don't go!'
His hesitation causes the egg to slide off the ledge and crack.
He screams 'Oh God!' as the egg breaks.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: No, no, no, actually we don't go, we don't go!
watch.why: The sharp contrast between his confident hype and instant, chaotic regret drives the comedy. His hesitation directly causes the failure he was panicking to avoid.
